The dataset labels May 2023 to March 2024 as El Niño. April 2024 has an ONI of 0.8 but is labelled Neutral in the data; this page keeps the dataset's labels. El Niño months form a single stretch of time, so price differences also reflect seasons and longer trends. Read them as association, not proof of cause.

Modal price

The most commonly reported wholesale price for a commodity in a market.

ONI

The Oceanic Niño Index measures sea-surface temperature change in the Pacific. Values of 0.5 or more signal El Niño.

Units

The market file lists prices per quintal (100 kg). They are shown here per kg.
